audience.notes: Australian couples in their 30s, planning in the AUD 150K+ band, comparing an overseas wedding with what the same day would cost at home. Paying parents read for where the money goes and currency risk. Avoid 'cheap', 'budget', 'under $X', deal language and cost-saving lists that attract the bargain hunter.

payload.search_intent: Informational with comparison intent: 'what does it cost overseas, and how does that compare with marrying in Australia?' Australian SERPs mix destination and home-wedding cost pages, so the page must answer both quickly.
payload.angle: A sourced, region-by-region picture of what destination weddings cost, set against an independent Australian home-wedding benchmark, for couples in the luxury band. Each regional section is short and hands off to our detailed cost guide. One section shows the costs averages leave out, and what an advisor actually handles.
serp_gaps_to_win: No ranking page compares destination costs with an independent (non-marketplace) Australian home benchmark.
No ranking page covers the luxury band; every figure is budget tier.
No region-by-region structure for Australians (Europe, Asia and the Pacific, Middle East).
Invisible costs (room blocks, currency and deposits, legal paperwork, transfers, wet-weather backup) are missing everywhere.
Most ranking figures are undated or unsourced; ours will carry source, date and original currency for every number.
PAA 'Who pays for travel for a destination wedding?' and 'Is it cheaper to do a destination wedding?' are not answered well by any top 3 page.

outline.h2: What is the average cost of a destination wedding?
outline.answers: The direct answer in the first 60 words: why there is no single honest average, what the published averages measure, and the realistic shape of a luxury destination budget.
must_include: A 40 to 60 word answer block under the H2 (snippet target), with the primary keyword in the first sentence
Say plainly that published averages mix elopements, all-inclusive resort packages and full-scale weddings, so they understate a 70 to 110 guest luxury wedding
Any figure: source, date, original currency, no conversion
What an average usually includes and excludes (guest travel, the couple's flights, planner fee)

outline.h2: How a destination wedding compares with a wedding in Australia
outline.answers: Is it cheaper or dearer than marrying at home? Fewer guests, higher per-head, plus costs a home wedding never has.
must_include: An Australian home-wedding benchmark from an independent source (researcher: ASIC Moneysmart or another non-marketplace source; NOT Easy Weddings or any figure derived from it)
Explain the per-guest logic in words (smaller guest list, higher spend per guest) without converting currencies

One sentence that our detailed side-by-side lives elsewhere, linked with a descriptive anchor such as 'our line-by-line comparison of overseas and home budgets' (never 'destination wedding vs home wedding cost')
Who pays for what: couple vs guests' travel (answers PAA)
Keep this section to about 300 to 350 words; do not rebuild the comparison page

outline.h2: Europe: Italy, Lake Como and the Greek islands
outline.answers: What shapes cost in Europe (venue exclusivity, season, catering minimums, euro deposits), at summary level.
must_include: Two or three sentences per destination, then hand off
Link our Italy cost guide and Lake Como cost guide with descriptive anchors (not 'wedding in italy cost' or 'lake como wedding cost' exact match)
If a figure is used, take it from the original source behind our guide (not our page), with date and currency
Greece: link the Greece destination page; Santorini cost pages need link-map approval first

outline.h2: Asia and the Pacific: Bali, Fiji and beyond
outline.answers: Why the region is closer and often lower per head for Australians, and what still adds up (villa buyouts, levies, guest flights).
must_include: Link the Bali cost guide but DO NOT repeat its figures (SITE-CONFLICTS: its USD range conflicts with the Bali hub's AUD range)
Link the Bali hub and Fiji destination page
No price for Bali at all in this article until SITE-CONFLICTS is resolved

outline.answers: Short note on Ras Al Khaimah, Qatar and Mexico as regions with resort-led pricing and different cost drivers.
must_include: Keep to about 150 words; no figure unless an official or venue source is found
Link the most specific destination pages from the link map
Writer may merge this into the Asia and Pacific section if sources are thin (keeps 6 H2s)

outline.answers: The invisible work: guest room blocks and attrition, transfers, wet-weather backup, legal paperwork and apostilles, deposits and currency movement, planner fees.
must_include: Currency and deposits across borders: show how a budget set in AUD moves when contracts are in EUR or USD, without quoting a rate (couple fear 4, paying-parent fear 1)
Hidden costs and mark-ups: what to ask for in writing (paying-parent fear 1)
Legal validity in Australia costs time and fees: link Smartraveller on marrying overseas; say requirements must be confirmed for the couple's own passports
Room block terms (attrition, release dates), link /travel
Link the planner cost guide and the all-inclusive cost guide with descriptive anchors
How a Wedded Wonderland advisor coordinates deposits, payments and currency (brand-profile proof point); no Concierge prices

outline.h2: How to work out your own number
outline.answers: A calm method: guest count first, then per-head at the venue, then the costs above, then a contingency and currency buffer.
must_include: Step list, 4 to 6 steps, no prices
Wonderland Studio's multi-currency budget tool as the free option
Link /packages as the place to see vetted properties (no package prices)
Soft CTA line: 'A free Discovery Call with a Wedded Wonderland advisor is a quick way to test your shortlist.'

payload.cannibalisation_verdict: Partial, not total. No page on our site targets 'average cost of destination wedding' or a region-by-region view, so a new page is justified. But the destination-vs-home comparison (the user's edge) is already owned by /destination-weddings/destination-wedding-vs-home-cost, and an 'average wedding cost' cluster already exists in practice.
payload.differentiation: This page answers 'what does a destination wedding cost, region by region' for Australians in the luxury band. It is the regional overview that sits above our destination cost guides and links down to each. The home comparison is one short, Australia-framed section that links to the existing comparison page rather than competing with it. Intent: informational overview with a handoff to detailed guides; the comparison page stays the deep side-by-side.
